text:
Carmen: quick q  I have 7 unused PTO days. My manager said I could keep up to 5 for next year. What happens to the other 2 if I dont use them? Also our team is planning a voluntary 2-day office pause Jan 6-7. Can I request carryover to cover those days or is that considered a blackout?

Morgan (People Ops): hey Carmen  short version: submit a formal carryover request in Workday with manager approval recorded. Standard policy: up to 5 days eligible to carry (unless local law overrides). Days over the cap are typically forfeited unless you separate from the company within the payout window, then payroll may process a payout on termination. Voluntary team pauses are not company blackout days, so you may request to use PTO/carryover for them, but manager approval is required.

Carmen: cool  can a manager approve via Slack or do they need to click approve in Workday?

Morgan (People Ops): manager approval should be in Workday. A Slack approval is fine as an interim note, but we need the formal approval recorded in Workday before cutoff to avoid manual processing. If your manager cant access Workday, screenshot their Slack approval and attach it to the request and cc people-ops.

people_ops_bot: Heads-up: PTO carryover processing cutoff is Dec 20 23:59 UTC. After cutoff, requests require manual payroll adjustments and may be delayed. See: <https://hr.example.com/pto-carryover>.

Vik: edge case: Im going on company secondment abroad from Dec 28 to Mar 2. Do I need to file before I leave, or can I do it once Im on assignment?

Morgan (People Ops): file before the secondment if possible. If you cant, open a ticket and include secondment dates and the local worksite. We try to process carryover before separated payroll cycles but will accommodate exceptions for international assignments.

Nadia: payroll question  if someone leaves and has unused days above the carryover cap, whats the payout timeline?

Morgan (People Ops): payouts on separation follow local law and payroll schedules. For US separations, payroll processes final payouts on the last paycheck cycle; for some EU countries, unused statutory leave may carry by law or have special notice rules. If you have a specific headcount, tag payroll and well confirm.

Carmen: thanks  one more: part-time folks pro-rate the cap, right?

Morgan (People Ops): yes, accruals and carryover limits are pro-rated for part-time. Workday displays available balances; if numbers look wrong, take a screenshot of your accrual history and tag us.

people_ops_bot: Case logged: HR-8110 for Vik (secondment + carryover exception).

Carmen: great, Ill submit in Workday and paste the link here when done. :white_check_mark:
